newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain Islamic Insurance listed on Bahrain bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain Islamic Insurance listed on Bahrain bourse.

text.p: The Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company (BIIC) has been listed on the Bahrain Stock Exchange, a bourse official said on Thursday.
"The firm's shares were listed on the bourse on Wednesday," the official told Reuters, adding that 20 million BIIC shares were listed.
In December, BIIC offered five million shares worth 750,000 dinars ($2 million) to investors to raise its paid-in capital.
Established in 1989, BIIC activities include all types of insurance except life cover.
